findings.area: PIT: observedAt of SEC normalizations too early; revisions not disclosed
findings.evidence: 6 as-of views (5 events) lacked a normalization that the final view applies, at or after the evidence's observedAt (stage filing date); pitHistory skipped visibleAt == eventDate and used visibleAt as 'until'. No bars, holds or evidence after asOf.
findings.resolution: canonical-price-validity-2.1.0: observedAt = first session whose as-of view contains the normalization (observedAtStage kept); pitHistory discloses every normalization with observedAt > eventDate (until = session before observedAt, resumeFrom = observedAt). No detection rule, threshold or valid bar changes. Tests R-F19, R-F19b fail on 2.0.0 and pass on 2.1.0. Re-measured by the next audit run.
